read.title: Black Friday Promotion Plan
read.text:
Team,

Our Vitamin C serum is eligible for a Lightning Deal on Black Friday. The deal will run for six hours at a 30% discount. We will also add a 10% coupon to the toner from Thursday to Monday.

Before the event, please make sure FBA has at least 2,000 units in stock. During the deal, keep an eye on the sell-through and the ad budget every hour. If the serum sells out early, pause the related ads right away.

After the promotion, we will compare sales and margin with last year.

Thanks,
Hana

write.en: Write a short note to your team about next week's Amazon promotion: which product was selected and what to watch during the deal.
write.model:
Hi team,

Good news: our hyaluronic cream is eligible for a Lightning Deal next Tuesday. The deal will run for eight hours at a 25% discount. During the deal, please keep an eye on inventory and ad spending. If stock drops below 300 units, let me know right away.

Thanks,
Minsu
